name: latex-selection-wordcount
description: Show selected LaTeX word counts and daily manuscript growth in the status bar.

commands.title: LaTeX Word Count: Show Daily History

latexSelectionWordCount.texcountPath.description: Path to TeXCount. On macOS, /Library/TeX/texbin/texcount is tried if texcount is not on PATH.

latexSelectionWordCount.rootFile.description: Optional main .tex file for the daily project count, relative to the workspace folder or as an absolute path. When empty, main.tex in the workspace is used if present.
